title: The Speaking Mistake That DESTROYS Your Score
hook: Are you making this one mistake that's killing your IELTS score?
scene_directions: [Mr. Yeti looks shocked, [sound effect: gasp], text overlay: 'The Silent Killer of IELTS Scores']
narration: Hey there, IELTS students! [Mr. Yeti waves] So, you're trying to get a high score, but you keep getting stuck at band 5? [Mr. Yeti looks frustrated, [sound effect: facepalm]] It's because of one simple mistake: not answering the question directly! [Mr. Yeti screams, [sound effect: scream]] Don't give a long introduction, just answer the question! [Mr. Yeti nods, [sound effect: nod]] Practice free at pielts.web.app
overlay_text:
Don't ruin your score
Answer the question directly
Practice now
topic: The Speaking Mistake That Ruins Scores
